page.layout: One printed page, one column of text, with centred headings and italic passages. No margin notes. Page number at top right. Catchword "no-" at bottom right.

main_text.head: FERDINANDVS VGHELLVS In Italia Sacra De Pontificibus Romanis in Leone IV.

p.i: Sed fabulam Ioanna egregie detexere Baronius in suis Annalibus, Leoque Allatius homo hoc doctissimo seculo eruditissimus in sua de-Ioanna Papissa Fabula, Commentatione, ita vt hic haud pluribus verbis opus sit ad iugulandum turpissimum commentum.

main_text.head: IOANNES RHO Mediolanensis S.I.P. In Interrogationibus Apologeticis ad Ioannem Baptistam Castaldum Interrogat. 4. pag. 69.

p.i: Hic enimuero mihi venit in mentem nobilis illius fabella, quam superiorum seculorum indiligentia progenitam, atque impio plausu a Sectarijs nouatoribusque exceptam Baronius, Bellarminus, virique alij oppido magni, & nuperrime Leo Allatius, eruditissimo edito libello profligarunt, de Ioanna Papissa.

main_text.head: FLORAVANTES MARTINELLVS In Imagine B. Mariae Virginis vindicata .

p.i: Et si vniuersa Chronica, quae sub Martini

page.notes: Corrected spelling: vniuersa read as universa under the u/v rule, and long s throughout. The line-end "de-" before "Ioanna" in the italic paragraph is printed with a dash; I kept it as "de-Ioanna" and it may be a justification dash rather than a true hyphen. Heading "vindicata ." keeps the stray space before the full stop as printed. Page-top stray marks at the left edge and the bottom edge are scan artefacts and were left out.
